Analisis ARDL Tinggi Muka Air (TMA) dengan Curah Hujan (PC) dan Kelembapan Relatif (RH)

Maulana Firdaus

2026-09-03

1 Pendahuluan

Dokumen ini memakai sintaks dan data analisis ARDL milik Kak Fajryanti, tetapi disederhanakan dari 4 peubah bebas (PC, TM, RH, WS) menjadi 2 peubah bebas saja:

Peubah Keterangan Peran
TMA Tinggi muka air (cm) Peubah respon (Y)
PC Curah hujan (mm) Peubah bebas 1
RH Kelembapan relatif (%) Peubah bebas 2

Data yang dipakai (harus berada satu folder dengan file Rmd ini):

  • Data_Harian_2022_2024.xlsx : data harian 1 Jan 2022 – 31 Des 2024 (1.096 hari), dibagi menjadi data latih dan data uji.
  • Data_Jan25_Mar25.xlsx : data harian 1 Jan 2025 – 31 Mar 2025 (90 hari), dipakai untuk peramalan di luar sampel.

2 Library

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(corrplot)
library(moments)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(dLagM)
library(dynamac)

3 Import Data

dataset <- read_excel("Data_Harian_2022_2024.xlsx")
dataset$Date <- as.Date(dataset$Date)

# Hanya TMA (respon), PC dan RH (peubah bebas) yang dipakai
dataset <- dataset[, c("Date", "TMA", "PC", "RH")]
str(dataset)

4.2 Time Series

data_long <- dataset %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TMA, PC, RH), names_to = "Variabel", values_to = "Nilai")

ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Date, y = Nilai)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ Variabel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Time Series Plot of Multiple Variables", x = "Date", y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal()

4.3 Matriks Korelasi

cor_matrix <- cor(dataset[, c("TMA", "PC", "RH")], use = "complete.obs")
cor_matrix
##           TMA        PC        RH
## TMA 1.0000000 0.3945932 0.5250838
## PC  0.3945932 1.0000000 0.4196228
## RH  0.5250838 0.4196228 1.0000000
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 50, number.cex = 0.8,
         title = "Matriks Korelasi", mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0))

5 Data Splitting

Data dibagi secara berurutan (tanpa diacak karena data deret waktu): 936 hari pertama sebagai data latih dan 160 hari terakhir sebagai data uji (sama seperti analisis aslinya).

total_rows <- nrow(dataset)   # 1096
test_size  <- 160

train_index <- 1:(total_rows - test_size)
test_index  <- (total_rows - test_size + 1):total_rows

train_2225 <- dataset[train_index, ]
test_2225  <- dataset[test_index, ]

cat("Data latih:", nrow(train_2225), "hari (", format(min(train_2225$Date)), "s.d.", format(max(train_2225$Date)), ")\n")
## Data latih: 936 hari ( 2022-01-01 s.d. 2024-07-24 )
cat("Data uji  :", nrow(test_2225),  "hari (", format(min(test_2225$Date)),  "s.d.", format(max(test_2225$Date)),  ")\n")
## Data uji  : 160 hari ( 2024-07-25 s.d. 2024-12-31 )
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  train_2225 %>% mutate(DataType = "Train"),
  test_2225  %>% mutate(DataType = "Test")
)

data_long <- combined_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TMA, PC, RH), names_to = "Variabel", values_to = "Nilai")

ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Date, y = Nilai, color = DataType)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ Variabel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Train" = "#00BFC4", "Test" = "#F8766D")) +
  labs(title = "Time Series (Train vs. Test)", x = "Date", y = "Value", color = "Data Type") +
  theme_minimal()

6 Kestasioneran Data (Data Asli)

6.1 Plot ACF

acf_TMA <- ggAcf(train_2225$TMA) + labs(title = "ACF TMA")
acf_PC  <- ggAcf(train_2225$PC)  + labs(title = "ACF PC")
acf_RH  <- ggAcf(train_2225$RH)  + labs(title = "ACF RH")
acf_TMA + acf_PC + acf_RH

6.2 Plot PACF

pacf_TMA <- ggPacf(train_2225$TMA) + labs(title = "PACF TMA")
pacf_PC  <- ggPacf(train_2225$PC)  + labs(title = "PACF PC")
pacf_RH  <- ggPacf(train_2225$RH)  + labs(title = "PACF RH")
pacf_TMA + pacf_PC + pacf_RH

6.3 Uji ADF

Hipotesis: H0 = data tidak stasioner; H1 = data stasioner. Tolak H0 jika p-value < 0,05.

adf.test(train_2225$TMA)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  train_2225$TMA
## Dickey-Fuller = -4.0015, Lag order = 9, p-value = 0.01
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
adf.test(train_2225$PC)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  train_2225$PC
## Dickey-Fuller = -7.5589, Lag order = 9, p-value = 0.01
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
adf.test(train_2225$RH)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  train_2225$RH
## Dickey-Fuller = -3.3561, Lag order = 9, p-value = 0.06101
## alternative hypothesis: stationary

6.4 Plot CCF

ccf_result1 <- ggCcf(train_2225$TMA, train_2225$PC, lag.max = 9) + ggtitle("CCF antara TMA dan PC")
ccf_result2 <- ggCcf(train_2225$TMA, train_2225$RH, lag.max = 9) + ggtitle("CCF antara TMA dan RH")
ccf_result1 + ccf_result2

ccf_pc <- ccf(train_2225$TMA, train_2225$PC, lag.max = 9, plot = FALSE)
ccf_rh <- ccf(train_2225$TMA, train_2225$RH, lag.max = 9, plot = FALSE)

ccf_all_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(Lag = ccf_pc$lag[, 1, 1], Correlation = ccf_pc$acf[, 1, 1], Pair = "TMA vs PC"),
  data.frame(Lag = ccf_rh$lag[, 1, 1], Correlation = ccf_rh$acf[, 1, 1], Pair = "TMA vs RH")
)

7 First Difference

7.1 Differencing

Pada ketiga peubah, plot ACF yang meluruh lambat menunjukkan data belum stasioner dalam rataan, sehingga dilakukan differencing orde 1.

DTMA <- diff(train_2225$TMA, differences = 1)
DPC  <- diff(train_2225$PC,  differences = 1)
DRH  <- diff(train_2225$RH,  differences = 1)

df <- data.frame(DTMA, DPC, DRH)
df.ts <- ts(df)
head(df)
DTMA DPC DRH

-4.375000 -0.18 -2.91
-1.458333 5.48 2.87
9.583333 3.75 2.39
-10.208333 6.72 4.06

7.2 Plot ACF

acf_DTMA <- ggAcf(DTMA) + labs(title = "ACF DTMA")
acf_DPC  <- ggAcf(DPC)  + labs(title = "ACF DPC")
acf_DRH  <- ggAcf(DRH)  + labs(title = "ACF DRH")
acf_DTMA + acf_DPC + acf_DRH

7.3 Plot PACF

pacf_DTMA <- ggPacf(DTMA) + labs(title = "PACF DTMA")
pacf_DPC  <- ggPacf(DPC)  + labs(title = "PACF DPC")
pacf_DRH  <- ggPacf(DRH)  + labs(title = "PACF DRH")
pacf_DTMA + pacf_DPC + pacf_DRH

8 ARDL dengan dynardl (paket dynamac)

8.1 Uji Kointegrasi (Bounds Test)

Uji batas Pesaran-Shin-Smith (2001) dengan ardlBound (paket dLagM), kasus 2, max.p = 1, max.q = 9. Jika statistik F melebihi batas atas I(1), maka terdapat kointegrasi (hubungan jangka panjang).

# try(): beberapa versi paket strucchange gagal menggambar plot CUSUM di akhir fungsi
# (error "invalid font type"), padahal hasil uji sudah tercetak seluruhnya sebelum plot.
invisible(try(
  ardlBound(data = as.data.frame(train_2225),
            formula = TMA ~ PC + RH,
            case = 2, max.p = 1, max.q = 9),
  silent = TRUE
))

8.2 Model

8.2.1 Jangka Pendek (Error Correction pada data differencing)

modelardl <- dynardl(
  DTMA ~ DPC + DRH,
  data = df,
  lags = list(
    "DTMA" = 1:9,
    "DPC"  = 1,
    "DRH"  = 1
  ),
  ec = TRUE
)
## [1] "Error correction (EC) specified; dependent variable to be run in differences."
summary(modelardl)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = as.formula(paste(paste(dvnamelist), "~", paste(colnames(IVs),

8.2.2 Jangka Panjang (data level)

modelardll <- dynardl(
  formula = TMA ~ PC + RH,
  data = train_2225,
  levels = c("PC", "RH"),
  ec = FALSE
)
## [1] "Dependent variable to be run in levels."

8.3 Uji Asumsi

res1 <- residuals(modelardl$model)

# Autokorelasi sisaan (H0: tidak ada autokorelasi)
Box.test(res1, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
## 
##  Box-Ljung test
## 
## data:  res1
## X-squared = 19.038, df = 20, p-value = 0.5193
# Normalitas sisaan (H0: sisaan menyebar normal)
jarque.bera.test(res1)
## 
##  Jarque Bera Test
## 
## data:  res1
## X-squared = 1281.6, df = 2, p-value < 2.2e-16
# Homoskedastisitas (H0: ragam sisaan homogen)
fitted_val1 <- fitted(modelardl$model)
bptest(res1 ~ fitted_val1)
## 
##  studentized Breusch-Pagan test
## 
## data:  res1 ~ fitted_val1
## BP = 1.3632, df = 1, p-value = 0.243
# Multikolinearitas (VIF < 10 berarti aman)
vif(modelardl$model)
## l.1.DTMA l.2.DTMA l.3.DTMA l.4.DTMA l.5.DTMA l.6.DTMA l.7.DTMA l.8.DTMA 
## 1.249782 1.570812 1.626521 1.687545 1.657613 1.664197 1.629196 1.518988 
## l.9.DTMA  l.1.DPC  l.1.DRH 
## 1.250541 1.153269 1.097102

9 Evaluasi Model pada Data Latih

Prediksi selisih TMA dihitung dari koefisien l.1.DPC dan l.1.DRH model jangka pendek, lalu diakumulasikan menjadi nilai TMA: TMAt = TMAt-1 + ΔTMAt.

evaluasi <- function(aktual, prediksi) {
  data.frame(
    MAE  = mean(abs(prediksi - aktual), na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((prediksi - aktual)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAPE = mean(abs((aktual - prediksi) / aktual), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )
}

# Fungsi untuk meramal: pakai koefisien model jangka pendek, lalu akumulasikan dari nilai awal
ramal_tma <- function(data_diff, tma_awal, model) {
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  data_diff$DTMA_pred <- coefs["(Intercept)", "Estimate"] +
    coefs["l.1.DPC", "Estimate"] * data_diff$DPC +
    coefs["l.1.DRH", "Estimate"] * data_diff$DRH
  data_diff$TMA_pred <- tma_awal + cumsum(data_diff$DTMA_pred)
  data_diff
}
train_baru <- data.frame(DPC, DRH)
train_baru <- ramal_tma(train_baru, tma_awal = train_2225$TMA[1], model = modelardl)

TMA_actual_train <- train_2225$TMA[-1]   # -1 karena differencing
TMA_pred_train   <- train_baru$TMA_pred

plot(train_2225$Date[-1], TMA_actual_train, type = "l", col = "black",
     main = "Train: Actual vs Predicted TMA", xlab = "Tanggal", ylab = "TMA")
lines(train_2225$Date[-1], TMA_pred_train, col = "blue")
legend("topleft", legend = c("Actual", "Predicted"), col = c("black", "blue"), lty = 1)

evaluasi(TMA_actual_train, TMA_pred_train)
MAE RMSE MAPE
31.66414 41.07022 5.13037

10 Evaluasi Model pada Data Uji

Data uji (160 hari terakhir) diramal dimulai dari nilai TMA terakhir data latih.

TDPC <- diff(test_2225$PC, differences = 1)
TDRH <- diff(test_2225$RH, differences = 1)

test_baru <- data.frame(DPC = TDPC, DRH = TDRH)
last_TMA_train <- tail(train_2225$TMA, 1)
test_baru <- ramal_tma(test_baru, tma_awal = last_TMA_train, model = modelardl)

TMA_actual_test <- test_2225$TMA[-1]
TMA_pred_test   <- test_baru$TMA_pred
date_seq        <- test_2225$Date[-1]

plot(date_seq, TMA_actual_test, type = "l", col = "black",
     main = "Actual vs Predicted TMA (Data Uji)", xlab = "Tanggal", ylab = "TMA",
     ylim = range(c(TMA_actual_test, TMA_pred_test)))
lines(date_seq, TMA_pred_test, col = "blue")
legend("topleft", legend = c("Actual", "Predicted"), col = c("black", "blue"), lty = 1)

evaluasi(TMA_actual_test, TMA_pred_test)
MAE RMSE MAPE
18.02884 24.49108 2.819428

11 Peramalan Januari – Maret 2025

Model yang sama dipakai untuk meramal TMA periode 1 Januari – 31 Maret 2025 dengan Data_Jan25_Mar25.xlsx. Nilai TMA awal diambil dari data aktual 1 Januari 2025.

data_2025 <- read_excel("Data_Jan25_Mar25.xlsx")
data_2025$Date <- as.Date(data_2025$Date)

DPC_25 <- diff(data_2025$PC, differences = 1)
DRH_25 <- diff(data_2025$RH, differences = 1)

test_25 <- data.frame(DPC = DPC_25, DRH = DRH_25)
test_25 <- ramal_tma(test_25, tma_awal = data_2025$TMA[1], model = modelardl)

hasil_prediksi <- data.frame(
  date       = data_2025$Date[-1],
  TMA_actual = data_2025$TMA[-1],
  TMA_pred   = test_25$TMA_pred
)

12 Catatan

  • Peubah bebas hanya PC dan RH; peubah TM dan WS dari analisis asli tidak diikutkan.
  • Hasil angka (koefisien, uji, MAE/RMSE/MAPE) otomatis dihitung ulang setiap kali Rmd di-knit.
  • Skema peramalan mengikuti analisis aslinya: hanya koefisien PC dan RH yang dipakai pada nilai selisih hari yang sama, sehingga kesalahan prediksi dapat menumpuk pada horizon yang panjang.
